change_policy: Evaluation-only no-action-commitment comparator. Training networks, checkpoints, calibration, and existing contracts v2-v8 remain unchanged.

action_timing.proposal_rule: every ActionNet query immediately records its deterministic top-1 argmax as the latest proposal
action_timing.deadline_rule: execute the latest proposal generated before the decision deadline
action_timing.forced_stay: none from threshold failure because every query creates a proposal
action_timing.intentional_stay: the latest top-1 proposal is STAY
action_timing.recurrent_state: all within-decision queries use pre-decision hidden; final query candidate commits once at the decision boundary

preserved_constraints: gaze-shift latency and 60 ms acquisition dwell

interpretation.selected_action_latency: diagnostic only; not a human response-time reproduction target
interpretation.pre_post_input_gaze: diagnostic only and not directly comparable with calibrated commitment modes

policy_sampling.action_policy: deterministic top1 at every periodic query
